construction_quality: Image suitability and human scoring boxes are confirmed; construction contours retain automatic boundary errors. Results are model-mask-conditional diagnostics, not human-contour-validated formal experiments.

decision_rules.background: Retain v2: upper 95% CI of median absolute change < 0.02 and lower 95% CI of paired Official-minus-repair reduction > 0. Report mean, worst and each case as well.
decision_rules.generalization: Two selected person videos from one generator cannot establish overall superiority; formal construction review, expanded independent cohort and natural preferences remain required.
decision_rules.sensitivity: Report start/middle/end signed subject drop and matched background changes on BOTH bases; uniform full subject blur remains a quality control. No score-based exclusions or parameter updates.

full_subject_blur: Retain as a separately reported quality intervention; uniform blur throughout a video does not necessarily reduce temporal identity consistency.
holdout: New videos and source prompts are disjoint from the seven scored development clips. Method and settings frozen before these new scores. Cohort was visually selected; no population-level superiority claim.
localization: Frozen human clean-frame prompts; rerun independent MobileSAM on each actual variant, then reuse only the hashed scoring masks across representation comparisons.
motivation: Late patch pooling cannot remove background already mixed by DINO self-attention.
natural_preference_validation: Required before a broad method-superiority claim; not replaced by blur invariance.
pilot_policy: Both user-accepted new source images remain in this run regardless of scores. The three-candidate selection ledger and rejected multi-person presenter are preserved.
preprocessing: Native uint8 RGB is cast float32 before DINO Resize to match VBench decoding. Earlier pilot measurements remain archived.
